clean-lead-120bpm.gateNote: Label octaves are first-pass estimates, so the required gate is on pitch class. Exact accuracy is still reported; a large exact/pitch-class gap points at the labels, a low pitch-class number points at the detector.

sixteenths.note: 125ms apart at 120bpm. Excluded from the required gate but always reported. Excluding it here is the ONLY sanctioned way to relax this fixture; the labels are never edited.

power-chords-c-a-g-e-c-d-fsharp-e-120bpm.gateNote: This fixture exists to prove power-chord identification, so the gate is on the full label (root + quality "5"). Switch to "pitchClass" to relax it to root-only.

cowboy-chords-c-d-em-g-c-d-em-am-120bpm.gateNote: Major vs minor is the whole point here (C vs Em vs Am), and that lives in the quality, not the root.

spicy-chords-cmaj9-g-am11.gateNote: Extended voicings. Accuracy is not the criterion — honest abstention is. The real gate is maxFalseLabels: the detector may say "unknown", it may not confidently say the wrong thing.
